ctx.x: He was playing piano. Yeah, he was playing piano.

I was playing the clarinet in the alto. Sam played the tenor in the clarinet. We had Sidney Fusier playing the ghetto or banjo. He could change either one. We would play there every night. We would come on there at 1030. Babe Carous Chum Club, Decayden Toulouse. That was our bunch. We had Roy playing drummer. The boy they called Roy. He stood uptown somewhere named Roy Evans. I think he was. Oh, I've heard of him. He died. Well, that was our drummer. Then we had the barrica band. We would play all them funerals,…
